summary.en: Multi-engine TTS & ASR plugin for DSH supporting Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, Breeze, DeepSeek, local MOSS, streaming read-aloud, live subtitles & orb, multi-role audio drama studio, and ecosystem integrations.
summary.zh: DSH 多引擎语音朗读与录音棚插件：支持小米 MiMo、豆包、Breeze、DeepSeek 与本地 MOSS，提供流式朗读、实时字幕响应球、/director 多角色有声剧合成及生态联动。
